gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent supratentorial glioblastoma (GBM) confirmed via prior histology by the site's neuropathologist or designate.

candidate_evidence.quote: Pembrolizumab (200 mg IV) given every 3 weeks.
lerapolturev + pembrolizumab: Lerapolturev delivered once intratumorally via convection enhanced delivery. Pembrolizumab given intravenously every 3 weeks.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: First or second relapse supported by MRI or CT scan; relapse is defined as progression following initial/prior therapy(ies).

role_evidence.quote: Lerapolturev delivered once intratumorally via convection enhanced delivery. Pembrolizumab given intravenously every 3 weeks.

flag.reason: Oncolytic virus is an excluded intervention type (manual 1.2); listed for denominator transparency, not a pharmacological candidate.

role_evidence.quote: Lerapolturev (PVSRIPO) and Pembrolizumab in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma

coder_notes: Single-arm trial; pembrolizumab is the only pharmacological antitumour agent, combined with an oncolytic poliovirus (excluded type). Trial kept as having an eligible candidate; adjudicator may wish to confirm how a virus + licensed antibody combination is handled. MGMT is mentioned only as a prior-therapy detail, not as selection.
